chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan mother in her fifties wearing a mustard-yellow kaftan with gold trim and a white headscarf.
chars.SON: SON: a young man with a short black beard drawn on his white head, wearing a teal hoodie and beige chinos.
chars.LADY: LADY: an older woman wearing a dark green djellaba and a beige headscarf.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young woman wearing a loose lavender abaya and a cream hijab.
chars.SIS: SIS: a teenage girl wearing a red sweatshirt and blue jeans, a ponytail scrunchie.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a traditional Moroccan salon with low colorful sofas and zellige walls, MOM proudly pours mint tea from a silver teapot for LADY and GIRL who sit as guests, a big tray of cookies on the round table. Warm welcoming mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In the same Moroccan salon, GIRL sits politely beside SIS on the sofa, both smiling and chatting shyly, GIRL holding a tea glass with both hands.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: GIRL modestly helps carry a tray of tea glasses into the salon with lowered eyes, while MOM watches her from the doorway with a delighted surprised face.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan kitchen with blue tiles, MOM leans close to SON and whispers to him with a big cheeky smile and a wink, pointing back toward the salon; SON looks embarrassed and happy.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: On a sunny seaside corniche promenade in a Moroccan city, MOM walks arm in arm with LADY in front, while SON and GIRL walk a polite distance apart behind them, both looking away shyly.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan salon, MOM holds both hands of LADY warmly and speaks to her seriously with a hopeful smile, LADY looks surprised and touched, a teapot on the table.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan house hallway, SON jumps in the air with joy behind a half-open door, fists raised, huge grin, while trying to stay silent.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In his small bedroom at night, SON sits on the bed staring at his phone with a confused face, scratching his head, a blank empty screen glowing.
